snippet.title: Salvation: Echoes of War | Launch Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Salvation: Echoes of War is a third-person stealth adventure set in a dark purgatory between worlds. Deadly enemies, solve haunting puzzles, and rely on your loyal companion to survive — and find your way back to the living.

Wishlist now: 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3741170/Salvation_Echoes_of_War/?curator_clanid=26335619

XBOX:
